concerns.text: FR-006 requires calculation and output of ΔR² (performance gap) between the composition‑only GNN and a structure‑aware baseline on a shared test set. No task in tasks.md produces this ΔR² metric; T007 only emits composition‑only results with a RF baseline gap, and T010 is a stub that does not generate scientific structure‑aware results.

SC-002 mandates measurement and reporting of the performance gap ΔR² between composition‑only and structure‑aware models. The current task set lacks any task that computes or records this ΔR², leaving the success criterion unaddressed.
